title: bursera covillei
intro: Bursera covillei, commonly known as the Mexican copal tree, is a species of tree native to Mexico and parts of Central America, belonging to the family Burseraceae. The health benefits of Bursera covillei include its potential to reduce inflammation and improve respiratory issues, such as bronchitis and asthma. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antimicrobial, antifungal, and antiseptic properties, making it a valuable remedy for wound healing and infections. The bioactive constituents of Bursera covillei include terpenoids, flavonoids, and other organic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
